subject.title: feat(android): port the working claw indicator, wait phrases, and turn recap

question: Should Android take the same working-claw and post-turn-recap product surface as the related web and Apple proposals once the cache-upgrade and real-device evidence gates are met?
rationale: This is a new Android user-facing behavior with a persistent cache-schema change, and the protected maintainer label requires a human to confirm the platform-parity direction rather than treating test-only evidence as acceptance.

options.title: Accept parity with proof
options.body: Keep the Android port, require the focused upgrade test and redacted emulator/device evidence, then review the exact head for merge.

options.title: Defer Android parity
options.body: Leave Android on its existing indicator until the broader cross-platform behavior has explicit maintainer product approval.

recommendation.title: Accept parity with proof
recommendation.body: Keep the Android port, require the focused upgrade test and redacted emulator/device evidence, then review the exact head for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed cross-platform author in the provided history and can clarify the intended parity contract.
